name: Sern Kou Resources Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成出售位于Johor Tangkak的两块工业地及地上临时建筑，代价RM3,970,000，由全资子公司Souncern Timber Sdn. Bhd.执行；其余公告主要为业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变动，未见新业务或产能扩张。
overview_en: During the year, the company completed the disposal of two contiguous parcels of industrial land with temporary structures in Tangkak, Johor, for a total cash consideration of RM3,970,000, undertaken by its wholly-owned subsidiary Souncern Timber Sdn. Bhd.; other announcements were mainly results, general meetings and company secretary changes, with no new business or capacity expansion disclosed.

segments.name: 木材加工与贸易
segments.note: 今年完成出售位于Johor Tangkak的工业地及地上临时建筑。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of industrial land and temporary structures in Tangkak, Johor this year.

actions.text: 上述出售已于2026年5月28日完成，收到现金代价后交易交割。
actions.text_en: The above disposal was completed on 28 May 2026 following receipt of the cash consideration.
